title: Vault: Go JOSE provides an implementation of the Javascript Object Signing and Encryption set of… (CVE-2026-116587)
description: A high-severity security vulnerability exists in the vault package's Go JOSE implementation, which handles Javascript Object Signing and Encryption standards including JWE, JWS, and JWT. Versions prior to 2.2.1-r1 are affected. The vulnerability impacts availability but does not affect confidentiality or integrity. A patch is available in version 2.2.1-r1.
